 - Project & stakeholder management: You can lead cross-functional projects with autonomy, bring people together around shared goals and break down silos to move work forward.

➡️ What we can offer you

 - Learning & growth: Benefit from coaching and exposure to different areas of Qonto, with opportunities to grow within the Strategy team and potentially explore roles in other functions over time.
 - AI & ways of working: Experiment with AI on projects and exchange practices with the team during strategy office hours.
➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Fanny De Vesinne-Larüe, our Strategy Director.

Before joining Qonto, she held roles across strategy, marketing, venture and e-business at financial institutions including AXA and BNP Paribas, working with fintechs and startups.

description:

If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.
About the role:
Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk https://www.camundacon.com/event-session/camundacon-amsterdam-2025/one-exporter-to-rule-them-all-exploring-camunda-exporter/?on_demand=true from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale
What You’ll Be Doing:
We are looking for a Product Builder to join the IDP & RPA pod. You will take real problems from customers, decide what is worth solving, and build and ship the solution yourself, using AI tools to get from idea to production quickly without lowering the bar.
Product Building is how Camunda's Experience organization builds the applications people use on top of Camunda 8, such as Hub, Operate, and ProcessOS. Small pods of builders own a product area from customer problem to shipped change, with no hand-offs between product management, design, and engineering. We are setting this model up now, so you will help shape how it works.
The IDP & RPA pod builds how Camunda processes work with documents and legacy applications. With intelligent document processing (IDP), customers create extraction and classification templates in Camunda Hub and publish them so a process can use AI to turn invoices and other documents into structured data. With robotic process automation (RPA), customers integrate legacy applications that have no APIs, using Robot Framework scripts on a standalone RPA worker. The hard problems come with putting LLMs into customer processes: extraction quality, model and prompt choices, testing and trust, and working for AI agents as well as for people.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
 - Help shape product direction for IDP & RPA by combining customer input, usage data, and field feedback into clear priorities.
 - Partner with the other builders and product strategy to turn problems into shipped features, using short written proposals and prototypes to align early.
 - Make judgment calls with incomplete information within your scope and own the outcome.
 - Communicate trade-offs and decisions clearly to stakeholders who don't live in the details the way you do.
 - Use AI tools across the whole loop, from specs to prototypes to production-ready code, and hold a high bar for what you ship by reviewing and improving the output rather than accepting it.
 - Build, test, and ship improvements to the IDP & RPA experience, reading errors and tracing issues far enough to give your pod useful context.
 - Talk to customers and to support and customer success colleagues about how IDP is used and where it breaks, and turn what you learn into decisions about what to build next.
 - Pick up customer incidents and trace them across Hub, the connectors, and the deployed process of the customer.
 - Track what you ship against real outcomes and adjust when the data tells you to.

title: Senior Product Manager - Omniverse Sensor Simulation
description:

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
Become part of NVIDIA's groundbreaking team in Berlin, Germany, as a Senior Product Manager for Omniverse Sensor Simulation! NVIDIA has driven innovation for over 25 years in computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing. Today, we are changing the future of AI by improving how computers, robots, and autonomous vehicles interpret their surroundings. This position presents an outstanding opportunity to engage with real-time rendering, physically based simulation, and synthetic data generation, advancing robotics and autonomous technologies.
**What you'll be doing:**
-------------------------
* Lead the product vision and planning for Omniverse sensor simulation capabilities, including lidar, radar, time-of-flight, and others.
* Develop AI-prepared simulation workflows for synthetic data generation, perception model evaluation, robotics simulation, autonomous systems validation, and digital twin testing.
* Translate customer needs into clear product requirements for sensor fidelity, performance, scalability, usability, and workflow integration.
* Partner with engineering teams on sensor models, fidelity, testing and validation, and simulation pipeline architecture.
* Coordinate sensor simulation capabilities alongside AI, robotics, computer vision, and simulation teams for model training, inference, testing, and evaluation needs.
* Drive roadmap requirements for scenario coverage, domain randomization, sensor configuration, sim-to-real validation, dataset generation, and automated quality checks.
* Explore AI-assisted workflows for scene generation, material authoring, sensor configuration, scenario creation, and developer efficiency.
* Prioritize features across developer APIs, SDKs, tools, documentation, examples, integrations, and reference workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers, field teams, and ecosystem partners to understand production problems, adoption blockers, and emerging use cases.
**What we need to see:**
------------------------
* BS or MS degree in Computer Science (or equivalent experience) with 12+ years of overall experience.
* 5+ years of product management, technical product management, engineering, solution architecture, or related experience.
* Proven knowledge of lidar, radar, time-of-flight, and ultrasonic sensors, their application in robotics suites, and techniques for simulating them.
* Proven knowledge of AI/ML workflows including model training, inference, evaluation, perception pipelines, or synthetic data generation.
* Capability to convert AI, robotics, and autonomous systems needs into priorities for rendering, sensor simulation, and developer platforms.
* Experience working with APIs, SDKs, developer tools, technical customers, and engineering-led product teams.
* Strong technical communication skills, including writing product requirements, roadmap narratives, workflow documentation, and launch materials.
* Consistent record to prioritize across complex technical domains and drive execution with multi-functional teams.
**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**
-------------------------------------
* Experience with Omniverse, OpenUSD, RTX, ovrtx, Isaac Sim, Cosmos, CUDA, or related NVIDIA simulation and rendering technologies!
* Familiarity with camera, LiDAR, radar, depth, segmentation, optical flow, event camera, or other simulated sensor modalities.

Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows, coding agents, automated testing, evaluation harnesses, or workflow automation.

title: Technical Product Manager — Market Connections
description:
**Company Description**
At Streem, we are building the next generation SaaS platform to empower the commercial management of renewable energy assets. Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition by enabling asset managers, investors, and operators to extract more value from their renewable portfolios.
Our platform brings together energy data, contracts and market mechanisms across European countries. Behind every useful insight is a connection to real-world data—and making those connections work is a product challenge of its own.
 **Job Description**
We are looking for a hands-on Technical Product Manager to develop Streem’s market connections and data integrations across European energy markets.
Your mission: make the data our customers need accessible, reliable and usable in Streem.
You will investigate how data can be accessed in different countries, build relationships with external providers, test technical solutions and work with engineering to deliver robust integrations. You will also turn what you learn into documented processes that make each subsequent connection easier.
The work combines product ownership, technical investigation and external relationship building. One day, you might be mapping the data-access process in a new country; the next, testing an API, investigating an incomplete dataset or working with an engineer on a new connector.
You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Customer Operations and Sales, with engineering support for production implementation.
You will be in charge of:
* Expanding Streem’s access to energy data across European markets.
* Prioritising connections based on customer value, commercial opportunities and technical effort.
* Building relationships with data providers and understanding their access requirements.
* Turning successful investigations into reusable integrations, tools and processes.
* Improving the reliability and visibility of our data collection capabilities.
 **Qualifications**
One of Streem’s core values is to “try to get better, always”. We are looking for someone curious, analytical and resourceful, who enjoys taking an unfamiliar problem and finding a practical way forward.
* **0-3 years of experience** in product management, solutions engineering, data analysis, technical operations or other relevant experience
* **Strong analytical skills**: you can break down ambiguous problems, identify missing information and test competing explanations.
* **Ownership**: you take responsibility for outcomes across your product scope, align the team around priorities, make dependencies visible and drive issues through to resolution.

title: Product Manager - Lead Buyer/ Demand Engine - Marketplaces/ PropTech
description:
properti is Switzerland's AI-native platform brokerage. More than 12'000 closed transactions give us proprietary data on pricing, buyer behaviour and seller conversion that no software vendor has. Every property we sell needs the right buyer, fast. And many buyers are also owners who will sell next. As Product Manager for the Buyer Engine you own the buyer side of properti: how buyers find us, how we build our buyer database, how we qualify and match buyers, how fast they get to a viewing and an offer, and how we turn buyers who own a property into our next sellers. You build it, you ship it and you prove it works in the numbers.
 Why this role exists 
 Our brokers win mandates because they sell well. Selling well starts with demand: more qualified buyers per listing, faster viewings and better matches. Today our buyer journey is still largely manual. We want to turn it into an engine that creates demand, qualifies buyers automatically and hands our brokers the buyers most likely to buy, at the right moment.
 At the heart of the engine is our buyer database. A large, well-qualified and well-matched database means every new listing starts with the right buyers on day one, sells faster and wins us the next mandate. The buyer side is also our largest untapped source of new mandates. Every buyer who owns a property is a potential seller. Capturing that opportunity systematically is part of this role. You are the lead product manager & builder for the buyer-engine / demand-side. 
 Demand creation and traffic 
 You grow qualified buyer traffic to properti through product levers: listing pages, search experience, saved searches and alerts, SEO and content that ranks.
 You work with Growth on campaigns and channels, and you own the product side: what happens once a buyer lands with us.
 You build demand for listings that need it: re-activation of matching buyers, targeted alerts and new ways to bring a property back in front of the right people.
 Buyer funnel and conversion 
 You own the buyer funnel end to end: from first visit to request, qualification, viewing, offer and purchase.
 You find where buyers drop off and fix it, with experiments, not opinions.
 You make sure every buyer request gets a fast, relevant answer, and that our brokers spend their time on the buyers who will buy.
 Buyer database, qualification and matching 
 You build our buyer database into a strategic asset: every buyer we meet captured once, with clean profiles, search criteria, budget, financing status and activity, kept up to date.
 You grow the database systematically, from our own listings, saved searches, valuations, partners and every buyer interaction across all regions.
 You build how we qualify buyers: intent, budget, financing readiness and timing, from self-declared to verified to certified with financing partners.
 You ship AI-based matching between buyers and properties, including properties before they go public, so that every new listing starts with a list of the right buyers.
 You build buyer nurturing that keeps the right buyers engaged until the right property comes.
 Opportunity leads: from buyer to seller 
 You identify buyers who own a property and need to sell, and turn them into seller leads for our brokers.
 You design the moments and offers that make a buyer think of properti as their seller: valuation, financing, timing of buy and sell.
 You measure how many mandates come from the buyer side and grow that number.
 Build, ship, measure 
 You prototype yourself with AI tools, test with real buyers and brokers within days and ship to production.
 You work closely with engineering and data to ship fast, measure impact and stop what does not work.
 You make the buyer funnel measurable: clear definitions, reliable data and one view of the numbers
 Who you are 
 Must-haves 
 6+ years in product management, with a focus on growth, funnels or marketplaces.
 Experience in real estate portals, marketplaces
 Strong hands-on mentality with a clear builder mentality
 A track record of moving traffic and conversion numbers with product, not only with marketing spend.
 You build with AI yourself: you prototype, write prompts and know the current tooling first-hand.
 Strong in data: you design customer databases and data models, set up funnels, run experiments and make decisions on evidence.
 You understand SEO, search and alert mechanics, and lead management.
 Fluent German and English. French is a plus.
 Nice-to-haves 
 Experience with CRM and lead management products used by sales teams.
 Experience in a scaleup between Series A and pre-IPO.
 What this is not 
 A marketing role that buys traffic
 A role that stops at the launch: adoption and impact are part of the job
 You don't manage/ lead a team

 Own audience expansion

 Understand each segment. Research what each audience needs, what motivates them to buy and what holds them back. Size the opportunity and set segment-level KPIs.
 Build dedicated journeys. Create tailored entry points, landing pages, recommendations and offers that speak to each segment's goals.
 Partner with Marketing. Test new angles, messages and offers together, and turn the ones that work into lasting product experiences.
 Decide where to invest. Review segment performance regularly and decide where to double down, iterate or stop.

 Outcome: campaigns that launch smoothly, delight customers and perform better each season.
 Own quality and efficiency across markets
 As we add markets and campaigns, our tools and processes need to scale without trading off quality. You'll own this as a core goal with clear outcomes.
 Improve how we manage our CMS, so it stays consistent as we scale.
 Make localisation smoother, so every market gets accurate, consistent content.
 Automate repetitive tasks, starting with campaign releases across markets.
 Set up a simple, reliable QA process with clear checks before anything goes live.
 Outcome: high-quality, consistent releases in every market, shipped faster and with less manual effort.
 What You Bring
 You're a hands-on growth PM who cares as much about getting the basics right as about the next big test.
 4–6 years in product management, with at least 2 in growth, CRO or e-commerce.
 A track record of running A/B tests end to end and turning results into shipped improvements.

 Clear, structured communication with technical and non-technical partners.
 Comfortable with ownership in a fast-moving scale-up, where you set priorities and say no.
 Nice-to-haves
 Background in DTC, subscription or food e-commerce
 Shopify experience
 What We Offer
 A high level of ownership in your role from day one
 A hybrid working model with a beautiful office in Kreuzberg
 Free lunches at the office
 30% employee discount on every. products

 30 days of annual leave

title: Entrepreneur in Residence Data (m/f/d)
description:
TL;DR 
 You turn GlassDollar's company data into a business: what we collect, what it's worth, who pays for it and how we sell it. You work directly with our CEO, with the product team and our engineers building what you define.
 Our data has grown faster than our ownership of it. It powers our product, but we haven't yet treated it as a product in its own right. Corporates, partners and agents increasingly ask for exactly the data we have – relationships between corporates and technology companies, signals like funding and acquisitions. Building the business case, the offer and the first revenue around it is the job.
 Who your work is for 
 Corporate customers in vclOS: Better search, recommendations and weekly company updates that make our core product stickier.
 API and MCP partners: A data product others build on – and pay for.
 AI agents & search: Data with provenance, confidence and freshness that makes our answers better than anyone else's.
 Marketing and sales: Directory, rankings and reports through a quarterly data release that bring in pipeline.
 When these conflict, the product wins.
 What you own 
 The data business case: which data we sell, to whom, at what price, and how it ties into our core product.
 The data roadmap , ranked by customer value, revenue potential and cost. You set priorities; engineers build and run at scale.
 Data products and packaging: API/MCP access, reports, rankings and premium datapoints – from offer to pricing.
 The data budget and partnerships: vendors, APIs, scraping partners and scouting effort. You test sources on real samples, negotiate, and build partnerships where buying beats building.
 Go-to-market with sales and marketing: first pilots, quarterly data release.
 Data quality as a selling point: coverage, accuracy and freshness we can show to customers.
 You work closely with our CEO, join product planning, and prototype datapoints yourself before handing over what needs to scale.
 What you´ll do 
 Your first 90 days 
 By day 90: we know which data customers will pay for, the first data offer is live with pilot customers or partners, relationship data is classified and measured, and there is a business plan for the data business for next year.
 Month 1: baseline and market 
 Analyse usage and demand: which data customers use in vclOS (PostHog, search queries) and what sales and customer success get asked for.
 Map our data assets: top 25 datapoints with source, quality, cost and customer value.
 Competitive landscape: PitchBook, Crunchbase, Dealroom & co. – where we are better, cheaper or unique.
 Next year's data budget as a business case with a cost per datapoint.
 Month 2: first offer – corporate–technology relationships 
 Define our strongest asset: corporate–technology relationships (mention, partnership, PoC, implementation, investment, acquisition), classified and measured.
 Package it into a first offer (API/MCP access, report or premium module) with pricing.
 Negotiate with 1–2 data vendors or partners where buying beats building.
 Plan the first quarterly data release with marketing.
 Month 3: pilots and business plan 
 Run 2–3 pilots with paying or committed customers or partners.
 Ship 3–5 new datapoints customers asked for; publish a kill list for the rest.
 Business plan for the data business: revenue targets, pricing, team and budget for next year.
 Start a monthly data review with leadership, product and sales.
 Requirements 
 Who you are 
 An entrepreneur with a data background – you've founded something, or built a data product from zero to revenue inside a company. Business-first, and technical enough to prototype alone. You'd rather sell a rough offer this month than a perfect one next year.
 Must-haves 
 5+ years with company, market or B2B data in a product, business or founder role, ideally at a data business, marketplace or SaaS company.
 You've built a product or business line from zero and owned revenue, budget or P&L.
 Commercial experience: you've packaged and priced a product and closed first deals.
 Negotiation with data vendors, partners or customers.
 Technical enough to prototype: Python and SQL for quick analyses and scrapers; hands-on with LLMs.
 Working knowledge of GDPR for company and people data.
 You explain data trade-offs clearly to customers, colleagues and leadership.
 Based in Berlin, or willing to relocate.
 Nice to have 
 Founder or early-employee experience.
 Buying or selling data from providers such as PitchBook, Crunchbase, Dealroom or company registers.
 Experience with API or data-as-a-service pricing and packaging.
 Knowledge of the corporate innovation, VC or emerging technology ecosystem.
 German at reading level: DACH registers and customers are a big part of our upside.
 Stack: Postgres, Hasura, Python, PostHog and LLM APIs.
 What this role is not 
 Not an advisory role: you build, sell and ship, you don't write strategy decks.
 Not BI or analytics: no dashboards for their own sake.
 Not a data platform architect: engineers own infrastructure.
 Not ML research: you use models, you don't train them.
 How we hire 
 Intro call (30 min) with our CEO: your background and a business you built or a data bet you made as an owner.
 Paid case (about one day). Around 500 companies from our database with their corporate relationship records. Assess what this data is worth: who would pay for it, how you'd package and price it, what it costs to produce, and what you'd fix first to make it sellable.
 Case review (60 min) with our CEO and Product Owner: your business case, assumptions and trade-offs.
 Team conversations (2 × 30 min) with sales and customer success, your future go-to-market partners.
 Offer. 
 What we offer 
 Salary band: €80 – €150k base
 Founder-level ownership of a new business line, with a budget and a direct line to our CEO.
 Room to grow: if the data business takes off, you build and lead the team around it.
 Fast impact: your data shows up for corporate customers, partners an

 Wir starten mit Rechenzentren: Wir steigern die Leistung ihrer Kühlsysteme und binden gleichzeitig CO₂ und Wasser. Mit bestehenden Proof-of-Concept-Partnerschaften sowie gesicherten europäischen und nationalen Fördermitteln gehen wir jetzt von der Forschung & Entwicklung in Pilotprojekte und die erste kommerzielle Skalierung mit führenden Rechenzentrumsbetreibern und Industriepartnern in ganz Europa.
 2 | Die Rolle 
 Wir suchen eine*n Chief of Staff (unbefristete Festanstellung, Start Februar 2027) , die*der direkt mit den Gründern an der Schnittstelle von strategischen Partnerschaften, Business Development, Fundraising und Operations arbeitet.

 Du startest als Interim Chief of Staff und übernimmst eine etablierte Rolle mit einer strukturierten Übergabe. Nach den ersten ca. 9 Monaten kann sich die Rolle gemeinsam mit dir weiterentwickeln, je nach deinen Stärken und den Bedürfnissen von NeoCarbon, z. B. in Richtung Partnerschaften, Business Development oder Operations.
 3 | Deine Aufgaben 
 1. Strategische Partnerschaften 
 Du treibst Gespräche zu strategischen Partnerschaften voran mit Industrieunternehmen und Akteuren aus dem Rechenzentrums- und Kühlungsökosystem
 Du bereitest Partnermeetings vor: maßgeschneiderte Präsentationen, One-Pager, Follow-up-Unterlagen und Meeting-Protokolle, auf Deutsch und Englisch
 Du strukturierst Partnerschaftsmodelle (z. B. gemeinsame Entwicklung, Pilotprojekte, Lieferung und Co-Innovation) gemeinsam mit den Gründern
 2. Business Development 
 Du unterstützt unseren Go-to-Market für Rechenzentren und hältst Pilotgespräche mit Betreibern am Laufen
 Du koordinierst Gespräche zu technischer Machbarkeit und Integration in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Engineering-Team
 Du hältst unser CRM (HubSpot) sauber und aktuell und vertrittst NeoCarbon auf ausgewählten Branchenevents in ganz Europa
 3. Fundraising & Investor Relations 
 Du unterstützt laufende Finanzierungsrunden: Investoren-Ansprache, Erstellung von Unterlagen und Koordination der Due Diligence
 Du pflegst einen strukturierten Datenraum und stellst sicher, dass wir jederzeit investorenbereit sind
 Du bereitest Board- und Investoren-Updates vor und hältst Investment Case und Finanzmodell aktuell
 4. Operations & interne Planung 
 Du leitest den quartalsweisen OKR-Prozess: Planung mit den Gründern und Teamleads moderieren, das OKR-Board pflegen und den Fortschritt nachhalten
 Du verantwortest den Arbeitsrhythmus: wöchentliche Teammeetings, Leadership-Syncs, Quartalsreviews und Kapazitätsplanung
 Du strukturierst interne Prozesse und KPIs, um den Übergang zur ersten kommerziellen Skalierung zu unterstützen
 Du verantwortest den Recruiting-Prozess: Stellenbeschreibungen und Ausschreibungen, Bewerber-Pipeline und Screening, Interview-Koordination, Angebote und Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder
 Du übernimmst bereichsübergreifende Projekte, wo nötig, von Förderanträgen über People-Themen bis zu Team-Offsites
 4 | Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Beratung, VC, Data Center Industry, Corporate Development oder einem schnell wachsenden Startup
 Wirtschaftlicher Hintergrund oder technischer Hintergrund (Naturwissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen, Mathematik) mit Business-Erfahrung. Du wechselst zwischen technischen und kaufmännischen Gesprächen und hast Freude daran, dich in technische Themen einzuarbeiten
 Erfahrung mit Partnerschafts- oder Business-Development-Prozessen (z. B. Unternehmenspartnerschaften, Pilotprojekte, Fundraising) und Sicherheit im Auftreten vor dem Senior Management
 Strukturiert und organisiert: Du baust gerne Prozesse auf, steuerst Planungszyklen und behältst viele Themen gleichzeitig im Blick
 Hohe intrinsische Motivation , an Klimalösungen zu arbeiten
 Interesse an der Rechenzentrums- und Industriebranche; erste Erfahrung ist ein Plus
 Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Fließendes Deutsch ist ein Muss 
 Unternehmerisch, hands-on und proaktiv : eine Generalistin bzw. ein Generalist, die*der vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung übernimmt und sich schnell einarbeitet
 5 | Was wir bieten 
 Unbefristete Festanstellung , Start Februar 2027, in Berlin
 Eine Rolle, die mit dir wächst: Nach den ersten ca. 9 Monaten gestalten wir deinen Fokus gemeinsam
 30 Urlaubstage plus gesetzliche Feiertage
 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und die Chance, ein Climate-Tech-Unternehmen mit großer Wirkung mitzugestalten und zu skalieren

title: Technical Program Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Momentaufnahme von Ihrem Tag 
 Als Technical Program Manager sind Sie maßgeblich an der Steuerung und Umsetzung von zwei bedeutenden Transformationsprogrammen im Fertigungsumfeld des Schaltwerks Berlin beteiligt. Sie arbeiten eng mit der Programmleitung und interdisziplinären Teams zusammen, um komplexe technische und organisatorische Themen zu strukturieren und zu steuern. Ihre Aufgaben umfassen die Koordination von Aktivitäten über verschiedene Funktionen und Standorte hinweg sowie die Verantwortung für ausgewählte Arbeitspakete, wodurch Sie einen direkten Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Fertigungsstandorte leisten.
 Wie Sie etwas bewirken können 
 Unterstützung bei der übergreifenden Steuerung und operativen Umsetzung von Transformations- und Standortentwicklungsprogrammen.
 Stellvertretung der Programmleitung in definierten Themen und Meetings.
 Übersetzung strategischer Zielsetzungen in konkrete Umsetzungspläne, Maßnahmen und priorisierte Arbeitspakete.
 Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung strategischer und operativer Workstreams von der Konzeptentwicklung über die Entscheidungsfindung bis zur nachhaltigen Implementierung.
 Sicherstellung der nachhaltigen Umsetzung beschlossener Maßnahmen einschließlich Nachverfolgung von Wirksamkeit und Zielerreichung.
 Koordination interdisziplinärer Teams sowie nationaler und internationaler Stakeholder.
 Was Sie mitbringen 
 Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwesen oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Langjährige Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, vorzugsweise im industriellen Produktions- oder Transformationsumfeld.
 Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische, organisatorische und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge schnell zu erfassen.
 Erfahrung in Transformations-, Industrialisierungs- oder Standortentwicklungsprojekten sowie in der Umsetzung strategischer Zielsetzungen.
 Starke Fähigkeiten im Stakeholdermanagement und in der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit.
 Ausgeprägte Entscheidungs-, Umsetzungs- und Ergebnisorientierung sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen strukturiert voranzutreiben.
 Über das Team 
 Unser Geschäftsbereich Grid Technologies ermöglicht ein zuverlässiges, nachhaltiges und digitales Netz. Das Stromnetz bildet das Rückgrat der Energiewende. Siemens Energy bietet ein führendes Portfolio und Lösungen in den Bereichen HGÜ-Technik, Netzstabilisierung und Stromspeicherung, Hochspannungsschaltgeräte und Transformatoren sowie digitale Netztechnologie.
 Wer ist Siemens Energy? 
 Wir bei Siemens Energy sind mehr als nur ein Energietechnologieunternehmen. Mit ~100,000 engagierten Mitarbeitern in mehr als 90 Ländern entwickeln wir die Energiesysteme der Zukunft und stellen sicher, dass der wachsende Energiebedarf der Weltgemeinschaft zuverlässig und nachhaltig gedeckt wird. Die in unseren Forschungsabteilungen und Fabriken entstehenden Technologien treiben die Energiewende voran und bilden die Grundlage für ein Sechstel der weltweiten Stromerzeugung.
Unser globales Team setzt sich dafür ein, nachhaltige, zuverlässige und bezahlbare Energie Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen, indem es die Grenzen des Möglichen immer weiter hinausschiebt. Wir blicken zurück auf eine 150-jährige Tradition der Innovation, die unsere Suche nach Mitarbeitern bestärkt, die unseren Fokus auf Dekarbonisierung, neue Technologien und Energiewandel unterstützen.
Hier erfahren Sie, wie Sie bei Siemens Energy etwas bewirken können: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 Unser Engagement für Vielfalt 
 Gut, dass wir nicht alle gleich sind. Vielfalt macht uns leistungsstark. Wir leben von Inklusion und unsere gemeinsame kreative Energie wird von über 130 Nationalitäten gespeist. Siemens Energy setzt auf den Charakter - unabhängig von ethnischem Hintergrund, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion, Identität oder Behinderung. Wir versorgen die Gesellschaft mit Energie - die ganze Gesellschaft - und wir diskriminieren nicht aufgrund von Unterschieden, die zwischen uns bestehen.
 Benefits
 Neben einer attraktiven, marktgerechten Vergütung erwartet Sie eine arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
 Darüber hinaus bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit, Aktionär von Siemens Energy zu werden.
 Wir ermöglichen unseren Mitarbeitenden flexibles und mobiles Arbeiten; unsere modernen Büros bieten zudem Raum für Zusammenarbeit und Kreativität.
 Die fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden hat für uns einen hohen Stellenwert. Hierfür stehen vielfältige Programme und Lernangebote zur eigenständigen Weiterentwicklung zur Verfügung.
 Im Sinne der Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben bieten wir ein breites Spektrum an Möglichkeiten, z. B. flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Kinderbetreuungsangebote an vielen Standorten, die Option auf befristete Teilzeit sowie Sabbaticals.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence für work2stay (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS · 100 % remote · bis zur Finanzierung ohne Gehalt · 25 % Beteiligung nach Funding-Milestone
description:
Wir suchen keinen angestellten Geschäftsführer, der ein fertiges Unternehmen übernimmt.
 Wir suchen den Unternehmer, der work2stay aus einer bereits aufgebauten Ausgangslage in ein finanziertes und wachsendes SaaS-Unternehmen führt.
 work2stay ist die KI-gestützte Pre-Check Engine für internationale Rekrutierung. Aus CV, Qualifikation und Unterlagen entsteht ein strukturiertes Kandidatenprofil mit Readiness-Report, offenen Nachweisen und den nächsten organisatorischen Schritten - als digitales Quality Gate vor dem Behördenprozess. (Work2Stay)
 Unsere langfristige Vision ist, work2stay zur operativen KI-gestützten Plattform für internationale Fachkräftegewinnung auszubauen - von der Qualifizierung und Prozessreife bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung. 
 Das MVP ist live und wird aktuell mit Pilotpartnern getestet. FLYACTS und ein erfahrener Venture Partner haben Problem, Geschäftsmodell, Produkt und erste Marktzugänge aufgebaut.
 Du startest dabei nicht allein: Das bestehende Founding Team begleitet dich insbesondere in der Übergangs- und Finanzierungsphase aktiv in Business, Brand, Tech und Company Development. 
 Dein erster Meilenstein ist klar: Du sicherst die nächste Finanzierungsrunde. Danach übernimmst du work2stay langfristig als Founding CEO und baust insbesondere Marketing, Vertrieb, Organisation und Team auf.
 Fachkompetenz im internationalen Recruiting ist hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung. Diese Seite kann perspektivisch durch einen fachlich starken Co-Founder aus unserem Pilotumfeld ergänzt werden.
 Deine Stärke liegt im Aufbau einer SaaS-Company:
 Kapital gewinnen. Vision erzählen. Kunden überzeugen. Menschen führen. 
 Aufgaben 
 Du entwickelst Finanzierungsstrategie, Investment Story, Pitch Deck und Finanzplan und führst den Prozess von der Investoren-Pipeline über Pitches und Due Diligence bis zum Closing.
 Du erzählst die Vision von work2stay so, dass Investoren, Kunden, Partner und zukünftige Mitarbeiter Vertrauen fassen und Energie entwickeln.
 Du gewinnst persönlich die ersten zahlenden Kunden und baust daraus eine wiederholbare Marketing- und Vertriebsstrecke.
 Du schärfst Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Pricing und Packaging anhand realer Marktreaktionen.
 Du übernimmst nach der Finanzierung die vollständige CEO-Verantwortung für Strategie, Zahlen, Team und Stakeholder.
 Du gibst dem Produkt die Richtung aus Kundengesprächen und Verkaufsdaten. Du musst nicht selbst Produktmanager oder Entwickler sein.
 Qualifikation 
 Du hast bereits ein Unternehmen gegründet oder ein junges Unternehmen in einer CEO- oder vergleichbaren unternehmerischen Rolle geführt.
 Du hast als Gründer, CEO oder federführend verantwortliche Person bereits mindestens 1 Mio. Euro externes Eigenkapital eingeworben und den Prozess von Investorensuche und Pitch bis Term Sheet und Closing selbst geführt.
 Du verstehst B2B SaaS und hast bewiesen, dass du Produkte vermarkten, verkaufen und zu wiederkehrenden Umsätzen entwickeln kannst.
 Marketing und Vertrieb sind für dich keine Funktionen, die du nur steuerst. Du kannst selbst positionieren, pitchen, Einwände bearbeiten und abschließen.
 Du kannst eine große Vision erzählen, ohne zu übertreiben. Menschen vertrauen dir, weil du Begeisterung mit Klarheit und Substanz verbindest.
 Du besitzt hohe Eigenverantwortung, Entscheidungsstärke und Belastbarkeit. Unsicherheit lähmt dich nicht, und Rückschläge verarbeitest du schnell.
 Du analysierst ausreichend, um gute Entscheidungen zu treffen – aber nicht so lange, bis das Momentum verschwunden ist.
 Du kannst Menschen führen, Vertrauen schaffen und unterschiedliche Stakeholder für ein gemeinsames Ziel gewinnen.
 Du identifizierst dich mit der Vision von work2stay und bist bereit, das Unternehmen nach der Finanzierung langfristig und mit voller Verantwortung zu führen.
 Du kannst die erste Phase bis zur Finanzierung wirtschaftlich selbst tragen.
 Du kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch.
 Benefits 
 Die Rahmenbedingungen transparent vorweg 
 Bis zum erfolgreichen Closing der vereinbarten Finanzierungsrunde erhältst du kein Gehalt und keine Gesellschaftsanteile.
 Mit dem Closing erhältst du eine Beteiligung an work2stay vor Verwässerung durch die Runde . Der Zeitraum ab deinem Einstieg wird auf das vierjährige Vesting angerechnet.
 Wird das Funding-Milestone innerhalb des vereinbarten Zeitraums nicht erreicht, endet die Beteiligungszusage ohne Anteilserwerb.
 Nach erfolgreicher Finanzierung ist ein angemessenes CEO-Gehalt Bestandteil des Finanzplans.
 Schick uns dein LinkedIn-Profil und beantworte folgende Fragen:
 Welche Finanzierungsrunden hast du federführend abgeschlossen?
 Welches digitale oder SaaS-Geschäftsmodell hast du bereits kommerziell aufgebaut?

title: Product Lead, Self-Serve Growth - Remote
description:
About Zyte
 Zyte is a leader in web data extraction. Our full-stack Zyte API and world-class data services help thousands of companies, from individual developers to global enterprises, turn the web into reliable, structured data. We're a remote-first, globally distributed team that ships fast and lets results speak.
This is a transformative moment for web data, and AI is reshaping both sides of the market. The world needs web data more than ever: to train models, power agents and feed AI applications, so the audience for web data is exploding - creating new personas and new buying journeys almost overnight. At the same time AI is changing how that data is collected - from manual work by engineers to automation with AI.
Zyte is unique in solving both challenges of web data - the software needed for reliable access to websites and the AI and skills needed to turn web content into structured data. We have an important mission in the AI revolution.
The role
We're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to lead our self-serve acquisition and growth journeys across the channels used by personas hungry for web data. Our users are engineers, data teams and the builders of AI agents, and your job is to understand what they seek, what they try first and what convinces them to stay.
You'll lead conversion and growth across channels: our website, agents an the developer ecosystem. You'll be product owner for the website and application UI and will take a data driven approach to customer acquisition and growth, from traffic through trial, activation and subscription, right up to an account-managed relationship.
Our goal is to engage 500,000 developers next year who need web data and this role is central to converting them. In this role you'll shape the rhythm of funnels and experiments, ideating and iterating with a talented team on how we can improve experiences, find truths in data and build on the insight of customers to figure out the next growth step. You'll be fascinated by how engineers evaluate tools, how AI is changing the way they build and what it takes to earn their trust. You'll work to explode an audience in a market that is itself exploding, and to be able to point at the growth curve and say "I did that".
What you'll do
Manage the self-serve funnel end-to-end. Define, measure and improve every stage: signup, trial, activation, conversion to paid and expansion.
Be product owner for the website and product UI. Set the roadmap and priorities for our web presence and platform UX, working directly with the development lead, engineers and designers to ship improvements that capture demand and drive funnel activity.
Optimise the funnel as a conversion mechanism - design and run experiments, work closely with our design and product marketing teams on formats, copy and narratives for conversion.
Optimise PLG journeys that start in the developer ecosystem. Optimise the buying journeys that begin in open source and in the emerging ecosystems of agents, turning developer adoption and ecosystem presence into activation and growth. This means deeply understanding developer workflows: docs, SDKs, code examples and the first ten minutes of hands-on experience.
Build intelligent customer data and nurture growth. Build customer data based on usage and firmographics, and use this to nurture customers for growth with tailored onboarding, relevant content and (with our RevOps function) identify when our sales professionals should reach out and make contact. .
Run a rigorous experimentation practice. Develop hypotheses, ship A/B tests and funnel experiments, and report results honestly, doubling down on what works and killing what doesn't.
 Requirements
 Proven results driving growth and managing funnels in a B2B SaaS or developer-focused business with a self-serve or PLG motion
 A deep curiosity about how engineers work and adopt tools. You've marketed or built for technical audiences and know that developers don't respond to marketing; they respond to products that respect their time
 Experience with developer tools, APIs, data products or technical audiences
 You prototype your own ideas: you use AI coding tools to vibe-code experiments, mockups and working demos rather than waiting for engineering capacity
 A track record of making websites effective engines for capturing demand and driving funnel activity; you've owned conversion, not just traffic
 Demonstrated success in customer growth and nurture: activation, free-to-paid conversion, expansion and churn reduction
 Intelligent, practical use of data: comfortable defining metrics, instrumenting funnels, segmenting customers and combining product signals with messaging and human outreach
 Experience working as a product owner or growth PM with engineering and design teams: writing clear requirements, prioritising ruthlessly and shipping iteratively
 Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; you can align marketing, product, CS, RevOps and sales around a shared funnel
 5-8+ years in growth, growth product management or lifecycle/funnel roles
 Nice to have
 You've written production code or contributed to open source
 Familiarity with experimentation platforms, product analytics (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4), marketing automation and CRM tooling
 Experience building product-led sales (PQL) motions or platform-to-enterprise upgrade paths
 How We'll Measure Sucess
 Signup-to-activation rate, trial-to-paid conversion, self-serve revenue and expansion revenue, funnel velocity and the quality of PQLs handed to sales.
 Benefits
 By joining the Zyte team, you will:
 Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team
 Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work
 Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe
 Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools

title: Senior Clinical Product Lead | 100% Remote within Europe
description:
About Docplanner And Noa
 Docplanner is a global healthcare platform connecting more than 300,000 doctors with approximately 100 million patients every month across 13 markets.
Within Docplanner, Noa Is On a Mission To Help People Live Longer, Healthier Lives. We Build AI That Works Alongside Doctors To
 Remove their administrative work.
 Help them make better decisions and handle repeatable cases, so they can spend their time where it matters most.
 Help patients navigate healthcare using their medical history as personalized context.
 We're already in doctors' hands: Noa Notes takes documentation off their plates, while Noa Evidence brings trustworthy medical evidence to the point of care.
The next frontier is the hardest—and the most valuable: helping doctors, and eventually patients, make decisions while our AI safely takes on repeatable clinical work. That's where a doctor's judgment has to live inside the product itself. That's this role.
 About The Role
 You’ll help take Noa from writing notes and providing evidence to helping doctors decide—ensuring what we build fits clinical workflows and earns doctors’ trust.
This isn’t a traditional CMO, advisory or regulatory role. It is a hands-on, individual-contributor clinical-product role. You will:
 Shape doctor-facing products by bringing real clinical needs and workflows into product decisions.
 Bring clinical judgment to what we build, including what is correct, useful and safe.
 Because you’re a doctor yourself, you can talk to our users peer-to-peer and get the honest answers a survey never will. As our first dedicated clinical hire on the product, you’ll help establish how clinical expertise informs Docplanner’s AI products.
You’ll work day-to-day with Product, AI, Design, Engineering, Regulatory and our doctor network.
What you’ll do
Shape what we build
 Bring how doctors really work—their habits, workflows and administrative realities—into the product.
 Talk to doctors across specialties and working styles, and turn candid feedback into product decisions.
 Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to prioritise and ship improvements, then learn from how doctors use them.
 Bring clinical judgment into the product
 Help define what correct, useful and safe looks like for our doctor-facing AI products.
 Review prompts, outputs, clinical templates and workflows, and identify clinically meaningful failure modes.
 Turn clinician feedback and evaluation findings into product and model improvements with Product, ML/LLM and evaluation partners.
 Keep it safe and scalable
 Work with Product, ML/LLM, Regulatory and the PRRC to align product intent, evidence, risks and controls.
 Build practical feedback loops with practising clinicians and our consultant-doctor network.
 What we’re looking for
 A medical degree and at least 2 years of direct clinical practice. Active licensure and current practice are not required.
 Meaningful experience shaping and shipping a doctor-facing or clinical product, either as a clinical product leader or a clinician-founder/builder.
 You personally owned product decisions, worked directly with Product, Design and Engineering, and shipped something clinicians used.
 You’ve turned clinical problems into product decisions—not just provided advice, review or governance.
 You combine strong clinical judgment with doctor discovery, workflow understanding and a focus on trust and adoption.
 You communicate clearly and directly across clinical, product, technical, regulatory and leadership teams.
 You’re comfortable operating independently as a senior, hands-on contributor in a lean cross-functional team.
 You actively use generative AI and understand its potential and limitations. Hands-on experience with prompting, output review or AI-assisted development tools is valuable.
 Bonus: Experience with ambient documentation, clinical templates, medical-knowledge systems, clinical coding or regulated Software as a Medical Device.
What success looks like after 6 months
 A clear, evidence-backed view of the priority doctor workflows and product opportunities Noa should address.
 Product improvements shipped based on doctor discovery, feedback and observed usage.
 Clear clinical quality expectations and feedback loops established with Product, ML/LLM and evaluation partners.
 Why join Noa at Docplanner
 Real impact at real scale: Your work reaches hundreds of thousands of doctors and their patients.
 Shape what comes next: You’ll influence what Noa and Docplanner’s AI products become—and whether doctors and patients trust them.
 Ship to learn: A feature in front of users beats another month of planning.
 Work flexibly: The role is 100% remote across eligible European locations, subject to local hiring arrangements.

title: Product Manager – Lead Buyer/ Demand Engine – Marketplaces/ PropTech – Remote
description:
Job Description
 Apply now for the position Product Manager – Lead Buyer/ Demand Engine – Marketplaces/ PropTech – Remote and let’s achieve great things together! Become part of a successful team and achieve success beyond your previous capabilities. Hungry for more? Properti is the leading and multi-award-winning PropTech broker in Switzerland. We combine highly trained experts with the latest technologies on an intelligent platform to provide customers, brokers and service partners with risk-free, flexible and simplified services. If you can imagine working at Product in Remote, apply now for the position.
Tasks
 Demand creation and traffic
 You grow qualified buyer traffic to properti through product levers: listing pages, search experience, saved searches and alerts, SEO and content that ranks.
 You work with Growth on campaigns and channels, and you own the product side: what happens once a buyer lands with us.
 You build demand for listings that need it: re-activation of matching buyers, targeted alerts and new ways to bring a property back in front of the right people.
 Buyer funnel and conversion
 You own the buyer funnel end to end: from first visit to request, qualification, viewing, offer and purchase.
 You find where buyers drop off and fix it, with experiments, not opinions.
 You make sure every buyer request gets a fast, relevant answer, and that our brokers spend their time on the buyers who will buy.
 Buyer database, qualification and matching
 You build our buyer database into a strategic asset: every buyer we meet captured once, with clean profiles, search criteria, budget, financing status and activity, kept up to date.
 You grow the database systematically, from our own listings, saved searches, valuations, partners and every buyer interaction across all regions.
 You build how we qualify buyers: intent, budget, financing readiness and timing, from self-declared to verified to certified with financing partners.
 You ship AI-based matching between buyers and properties, including properties before they go public, so that every new listing starts with a list of the right buyers.
 You build buyer nurturing that keeps the right buyers engaged until the right property comes.
 Opportunity leads: from buyer to seller
 You identify buyers who own a property and need to sell, and turn them into seller leads for our brokers.
 You design the moments and offers that make a buyer think of properti as their seller: valuation, financing, timing of buy and sell.
 You measure how many mandates come from the buyer side and grow that number.
 ﻿
 Build, ship, measure
 You prototype yourself with AI tools, test with real buyers and brokers within days and ship to production.
 You work closely with engineering and data to ship fast, measure impact and stop what does not work.
 You make the buyer funnel measurable: clear definitions, reliable data and one view of the numbers
 Job requirements
 Who You Are
 Must-haves
 6+ years in product management, with a focus on growth, funnels or marketplaces.
 Experience in real estate portals, marketplaces
 Strong hands-on mentality with a clear builder mentality
 A track record of moving traffic and conversion numbers with product, not only with marketing spend.
 You build with AI yourself: you prototype, write prompts and know the current tooling first-hand.
 Strong in data: you design customer databases and data models, set up funnels, run experiments and make decisions on evidence.
 You understand SEO, search and alert mechanics, and lead management.
 Fluent German and English. French is a plus.
 Nice-to-haves
 Experience with CRM and lead management products used by sales teams.
 Experience in a scaleup between Series A and pre-IPO.
 What this is not
 A marketing role that buys traffic
 A role that stops at the launch: adoption and impact are part of the job
 You don't manage/ lead a team
 Job advantages
What you get
 Full ownership of one of properti's core growth engines.
